# String ids a translation is allowed to omit, so that a string forgotten in one
# language stays distinguishable from one left in English on purpose.
# Checked by .github/scripts/check_resources.py.

# The application name is a proper noun, identical in every language.
AppName

# Labels of the custom fields written into the .FIT file. They are column names
# inside a data file, read afterwards on Garmin Connect and Strava. Translating
# them would make one athlete's own files inconsistent with each other the day
# they change the watch language.
GapFieldLabel
ReserveFieldLabel
SustainFieldLabel
WorkFieldLabel
CsFieldLabel
DPrimeFieldLabel
CarbFieldLabel
EccentricFieldLabel
